rationale: New public subscriptions use Shopify App Pricing and the Partner API Active Subscription query. Existing Billing API subscriptions remain readable and entitled until they are migrated with Shopify's migration tooling; the app must not create new Billing API subscriptions once SHOPIFY_BILLING_MODE=shopify_app_pricing.

requires: Configure Starter, Growth, Pro, Unlimited as Shopify App Pricing public monthly plans
Set a 10-day free trial on every public plan
Configure plan descriptions for every published listing language
Configure a welcome link back to the app
Create a Partner API client with Manage apps permission
Create a Partner API client with Manage apps permission and store only SHOPIFY_PARTNER_API_ACCESS_TOKEN as a hosted secret; organization/app identifiers are committed runtime configuration.
Test hosted plan selection and Active Subscription API on the development/staging store
Migrate any existing Billing API subscriptions before allowing those merchants to change plans

subscription_read_order: legacy Admin API activeSubscriptions fallback for unmigrated Billing API merchants

manual_pricing_legacy_compatibility.migration_method: Partner Dashboard subscription migration tool or Shopify CLI subscription-migrations
manual_pricing_legacy_compatibility.access_policy: Existing valid Billing API subscriptions retain their mapped VSN entitlements until migration completes.
